proposed_de_decision_entry.title: V1 shipping-time facts are policy-first
proposed_de_decision_entry.text: V1 provides Owner-approved, versioned shop/product shipping policy facts. V1 does not derive per-order expected or committed shipping dates. Policy facts must carry trusted merchant/store/(applicable account) scope, declared nature (expected vs committed per approved semantics), evidence and approval records. Buyer text, AI output, page free text and message observedAt can never become a shipping-time fact.

approved_principles.text: V1 的事实来源是 Owner 明确批准的版本化发货政策。
政策必须绑定可信的商家、店铺及适用账号关系。
政策适用范围与声明性质分别表达：范围=店铺/商品政策（本轮不生成订单级时间事实）；性质=预计或承诺，必须来自已批准语义，不能根据措辞自行猜测。
通用政策不自动证明某商品或某订单适用。
无可信订单起算时间、商品适用性和批准算法时，不计算订单日期。
不从发货政策推导预计送达时间。
政策事实可用与订单时间未知可以同时成立。
AI 输出、买家自述、页面自由文本、消息 observedAt 均不能自行成为发货时间事实。
本轮不建设完整订单读取、SKU 管理或 RAG 系统；原始任务如要求相关能力，列为依赖缺口。

fields.name: policy_id
fields.semantics: stable identity of the policy record

fields.name: policy_version
fields.semantics: monotonic version of the approved text; a new version never silently replaces an older one without an explicit replacement relation

fields.name: policy_text_ref
fields.semantics: reference to the Owner-supplied policy text and its evidence (document id/location), never the raw platform payload

fields.name: owner_approval
fields.semantics: { approved_by, approved_at, approval_evidence_ref } — without it the policy is not usable

fields.name: store_id
fields.semantics: trusted store scope; a policy without a store binding is not usable

fields.name: platform_account_id
fields.semantics: applicable account relation when the policy is account-specific

fields.name: applicability
fields.semantics: STORE_WIDE | PRODUCT_SCOPED | UNDETERMINED; a store-wide policy never proves product-level applicability by itself

fields.name: product_scope
fields.semantics: { include[]/exclude[], resolution: CONFIRMED | NOT_APPLICABLE | UNDETERMINED } — product/exception scope is DECLARED data, never inferred

fields.name: clock_start
fields.semantics: the declared event that starts the countdown; MUST be declared by the approved policy (no default payment-time rule)

fields.name: ship_complete_definition
fields.semantics: what 'shipped' means for this policy (declared); a printed waybill is NOT assumed to mean shipped

fields.name: time_value
fields.semantics: { type: CONTINUOUS_HOURS | BUSINESS_DAYS | DATE | INTERVAL, value/interval }

fields.name: nature
fields.semantics: EXPECTED | COMMITTED — must come from the approved semantics; it is never derived from wording

fields.name: timezone
fields.semantics: required when the value uses local dates/business days; missing timezone makes such values unusable

fields.name: business_calendar
fields.semantics: required for BUSINESS_DAYS; not required for CONTINUOUS_HOURS

fields.name: cut_off
fields.semantics: declared order cut-off rule when the policy defines one

fields.name: lifecycle
fields.semantics: ACTIVE | SUPERSEDED | REVOKED + optional replaces/revoked_by relation

explicit_distinctions.不适用 (NOT_APPLICABLE): the policy exists and the declared scope excludes this product/store situation — a decided outcome
explicit_distinctions.明确不存在 (ABSENT): the Owner has declared that no policy exists for this scope — a decided outcome
explicit_distinctions.未知 (UNKNOWN): the policy may exist but cannot be identified, scoped, versioned or validated — never filled with an inferred value

prohibitions: CONTINUOUS_HOURS values must NOT be forced to carry a business calendar
pure policy durations must NOT be converted into absolute timestamps by the fact layer
business-day and local-date rules REQUIRE sufficient calendar/timezone semantics
no assumption that a printed waybill equals shipped
no delivery-ETA derivation from the shipping policy

shape.applicability: STORE_WIDE | PRODUCT_SCOPED | PRODUCT_APPLICABILITY_CONFIRMED | PRODUCT_APPLICABILITY_UNDETERMINED | NOT_APPLICABLE | POLICY_MISSING

lane_b_registration_design.goal: a minimal, governed way to register Owner-declared identity material and a content-confirmed policy version, without activating it and without touching canonical schema

steps.question: 如何登记 Owner 声明的身份材料
steps.design: register a DECLARATION record: { platform, owner_declared_identifier (raw string), identifier_source: OWNER_DECLARED, platform_binding: UNVERIFIED, declared_at, basis_ref }. The raw string is stored verbatim and never rewritten, hashed into an id, or promoted to a platform reference. No numeric requirement is imposed on external_ref, but also no uniqueness/stability claim is made.

steps.question: 如何验证外部引用与目标店铺的关系
steps.design: verification is a separate state transition (UNVERIFIED -> VERIFIED/REJECTED), performed by a trusted Main-side check against the controlled session's own identity evidence (e.g. the shop id/account the authenticated session reports), never by name matching and never by another merchant's data. Until that transition, the declaration can only be listed, never used for policy matching.

steps.question: 如何创建内部实体并防止跨店误绑定
steps.design: mint an application-generated internal id (e.g. store-<internal-uuid>) that is stored separately from the platform external reference; bind it to the app-owned workspace merchant only; enforce the existing scope rules (merchant+store, optional account) and fail closed on any mismatch; forbid reusing controlled test shop ids and forbid auto-linking an existing shops slot.

steps.question: 如何保存已确认但尚未生效的政策版本
steps.design: store the content-confirmed version as lifecycle DRAFT/NOT_EFFECTIVE with owner_approval={basis_ref, verbatim_text_ref} and effective{from:null,to:null}; it is listable and auditable but unreachable by evaluation (the Lane A contract already refuses DRAFT/NOT_EFFECTIVE).

steps.question: 激活时检查哪些身份、批准、有效期和适用范围条件
steps.design: activation requires ALL of: (a) store/platform account VERIFIED against the controlled session, (b) Owner approval record present, (c) explicit effective window (from set, to null or a date), (d) declared applicability/product scope resolved, (e) declared nature/time_value/clock_start/ship_complete complete and consistent with the confirmed text, (f) required timezone/calendar present for the declared time-value type. Any missing item keeps the policy NOT_EFFECTIVE with an explicit reason code.

steps.question: 如何处理撤销、替代以及同范围冲突
steps.design: lifecycle transitions are explicit (ACTIVE -> SUPERSEDED with replaces=<old id>, or -> REVOKED); same-scope conflicts without an approved replacement relation resolve to UNKNOWN (already implemented in the Lane A contract); historical commitments keep their original policy version and are never silently rewritten.

steps.question: 如何确保一般政策查询不升级为订单级时间结论
steps.design: the registration and query path returns policy facts plus restriction reasons only; the output contract has no order-date/ETA field (pinned null), requires a trusted order-start fact before any order-level statement could exist, and the Lane A invariants (newness=NEWNESS_UNVERIFIED, automaticProcessingEligible=false) are asserted for every result.
